select_groups.title: Host groups
select_groups.description: Each monitored host in the selected groups becomes a device in Home Assistant, with its availability, problems and maintenance status.

select_items.title: Items
select_items.description:
Choose which Zabbix items (checks) become entities.

- **Zabbix server + tagged**: the Zabbix server's own statistics (version, hosts, items, values per second, queue, caches) plus every item carrying the tag below.
- **Tagged only**: only items carrying the tag below. Add the tag to items, item prototypes or templates in Zabbix.
- **All items**: every item on every selected host.

⚠️ **All items** can create a very large number of entities. A fully templated Zabbix host commonly has hundreds, sometimes thousands, of items, because discovery rules (filesystems, interfaces, services, containers…) create one item per discovered object. Only choose it if you know what you are doing.

data_description.tag: Items with a tag of this name (any value) become entities.

confirm_all.title: Import all items?
confirm_all.description:
⚠️ The selected host groups contain **{hosts}** hosts with **{items}** enabled items. The largest host, {largest_host}, has {largest_count} items.

Every item becomes an enabled entity that is polled and recorded by Home Assistant. This can slow Home Assistant down and grow its database quickly.
